keyPoints.en: Member System (1951): local leaders held portfolios — training for self-rule.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem Ahli (1951): pemimpin tempatan memegang portfolio — latihan pemerintahan sendiri.

keyPoints.en: Dato' Onn left UMNO and formed the IMP (1951); Tunku became UMNO president.
keyPoints.bm: Dato' Onn keluar UMNO dan menubuhkan IMP (1951); Tunku menjadi presiden UMNO.

keyPoints.en: The British made unity a condition for independence.
CLC (1949) brought leaders of different races together.
UMNO–MCA pact won the 1952 Kuala Lumpur municipal election.
keyPoints.bm: Pakatan UMNO–MCA memenangi pilihan raya perbandaran Kuala Lumpur 1952.

keyPoints.en: MIC joined in 1954, forming the Alliance (UMNO–MCA–MIC).

tip.en: Remember the dates as a ladder: 49 → 52 → 54 → 55.

keyPoints.en: London talks (Jan–Feb 1956): 4 rulers' + 4 Alliance representatives, led by Tunku.
keyPoints.bm: Rundingan London (Jan–Feb 1956): 4 wakil raja + 4 wakil Perikatan, diketuai Tunku.

keyPoints.en: London Agreement, 8 Feb 1956: independence by 31 Aug 1957 if possible.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian London, 8 Feb 1956: merdeka pada 31 Ogos 1957 jika boleh.

keyPoints.en: Reid Commission: 5 members from Britain, Australia, India and Pakistan; 131 memoranda.
keyPoints.bm: Suruhanjaya Reid: 5 ahli dari Britain, Australia, India dan Pakistan; 131 memorandum.

keyPoints.en: Social contract: citizenship for non-Malays; Malay special position, Islam and Malay language protected.
keyPoints.bm: Kontrak sosial: kerakyatan untuk bukan Melayu; kedudukan istimewa Melayu, Islam dan bahasa Melayu dilindungi.
